messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: [P1] Spike in errors and extreme tail latency for /v1/embeddings (hosted, us-west-2). Error rate ~28%, P95 ~88s, first seen ~2026-03-15T21:40Z. Dash: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/runs/embeddings-usw2
Alex Chen: Ack. Paging on-call. I'm taking incident lead. Priya, Samir — please triage infra and cloud contacts.
Priya Nair: I'm on it. Quick checks: control plane fine, autoscaler healthy. Noted elevated 502/504 and TCP retransmits on serving fleet egress. Collecting instance details.
Samir Patel: Opening AWS support case and pulling VPC/instance inventory.
Priya Nair: Running instance query for embeddings ASG.
Priya Nair: ```
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=tag:Service,Values=redwood-embeddings" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].[InstanceId,PrivateIpAddress,Placement.AvailabilityZone]'
```
Priya Nair: Results: i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b1 (us-west-2a), i-0b2c3d4e5f6a7b1c2 (us-west-2b), i-0c3d4e5f6a7b1c2d3 (us-west-2c). VPC vpc-0aa11bb22cc.
Samir Patel: AWS case 5689123456 created; pinged TAM Maria.
Maria (AWS TAM): Case acknowledged. Initial triage suggests intermittent ENI detach/flaps on a subset of hypervisors. Investigating host NIC/ENA driver and firmware. Requesting pcap/tcpdump from affected instances.
Priya Nair: Starting tcpdump on eth0 for 60s and will scp to ops node.
Priya Nair: ```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/embeddings-err-usw2.pcap 'port 443' -c 10000
scp /tmp/embeddings-err-usw2.pcap ops@redwood-secure:/tmp/
```
Lia Gomez: Drafting public status update & customer email. Proposed status page text:
"We are investigating elevated errors and increased latency for the embeddings API in the US-West (us-west-2) region. Some requests may fail or time out. We are working with our cloud provider to identify and mitigate the issue. Next update in 30 minutes."
Alex Chen: Approve, but add impact scope: hosted customers in us-west-2 for embeddings only; no data loss. Add AWS case id. Lia, prep customer-facing email and internal exec blurb.
Lia Gomez: Customer email (short):
"We're investigating increased errors and latency for the embeddings endpoint in US-West. Engineers and our cloud provider are working on mitigation. If you experience production impact, contact support@redwood.ai with severity details. Updates in 30 minutes."
Morgan (on-call): Mitigation suggestions:
 - targeted per-tenant regional failover for highest-severity tenants
 - throttle concurrency + increase client retry/backoff
 - reduce batch size to minimize tokenization and model tail latency
Alex Chen: No global DNS flip. We'll do per-tenant failover for corp-A, corp-B as canaries. Samir, prepare route overrides and rollback steps.
Samir Patel: Route override API call ready:
```
POST /v1/routes/override
{ "tenant": "corp-A", "region": "us-east-1", "reason": "embed-usw2-degradation" }
```
I'll apply to corp-A then corp-B and watch health in us-east.
Priya Nair: Applying local mitigations: reduce EMB_BATCH_SIZE to 16 and EMB_MAX_CONCURRENCY to 50 on us-west ASG.
Priya Nair: ```
# temp config
EMB_BATCH_SIZE=16
EMB_MAX_CONCURRENCY=50
``` 
Priya Nair: Patch applied to ASG. Monitoring.
Incident Bot: Metric update: error rate down 30% -> 18% after batching change. P95 latency improved 95s -> 60s on some nodes; still above SLO.
Samir Patel: Executed per-tenant failover for corp-A and corp-B; traffic confirmed shifted.
Alex Chen: Lia publish status page and trigger customer notifications for impacted tenants. Include AWS case 5689123456 and note targeted failovers performed.
Lia Gomez: Status page updated and email queued to cs-ops for immediate send to impacted customers.
Maria (AWS TAM): Quick AWS update: identified EC2 hosts with ENI flaps traced to NIC firmware regression. Host remediation (driver/firmware rollout) in progress. ETA for first remediation wave ~25 minutes. We will share host IDs and can perform instance replacements if you need immediate isolation. Also confirming EFA/ENA both affected.
Alex Chen: Can AWS do evacuations for stateless instances? That may help.
Maria (AWS TAM): Yes — we can perform instance replacement (stop/start or live evacuate) for your instances on impacted hosts; expect brief connection interruptions. Let us know list of candidate instance IDs.
Priya Nair: I'll prefer coordinated AWS evacuations for stateless workers. Stateful/real-time tenants keep failover. Samir, list candidates.
Samir Patel: Candidates: i-0b2c3d4e5f6a7b1c2, i-0c3d4e5f6a7b1c2d3. Requesting instance replacement now.
Morgan (on-call): Handoff to night team: Priya will own mitigation and monitoring. Actions: continue AWS coordination, monitor error and latency graphs, extend per-tenant failover as necessary, collect artifacts for RCA. Next update in ~20-30m or on AWS wave completion.
Priya Nair: Taking handoff. I'll be postmortem owner. Creating follow-up ticket PMT-4523 for RCA and customer impact assessment.
Alex Chen: Postmortem checklist: timeline of events, impacted tenant list, justification for mitigations, estimated costs from failovers/extra egress, potential SLA credits if >1hr. Lia prepare internal exec and support templates.
Lia Gomez: Internal comms draft:
"TL;DR: Elevated errors and latency for embeddings API in us-west-2 due to cloud provider NIC firmware issue causing intermittent ENI detaches. Mitigations taken: reduced batch size, targeted per-tenant failovers (2 tenants), instance replacements requested for stateless workers, AWS host remediation ongoing. Impact: several enterprise tenants experienced degraded embeddings; no data loss. Postmortem owner: Priya Nair."
Alex Chen: Sounds good. Any other asks? If AWS confirms full remediation we'll post final update and close incident once metrics stabilize.
Maria (AWS TAM): Wave 1 remediation complete; ENI flaps reduced on remediated hosts. Continuing monitoring and will deliver a full list of affected host IDs and timeline after wave 2.
Incident Bot: Next scheduled auto-update in 25 minutes or upon significant change.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Handing overnight to Priya. I'll remain reachable. :heavy_check_mark:
Priya Nair: Handoff accepted. I'll post follow-ups and update the status page with final remediation confirmation once AWS finishes.
